info.name: E² Stories OTT — Complete API Collection
info.description:
Single, complete API collection for the E² Stories (Entertainment Squared) OTT Platform.

Organised into 3 top-level sections:
- MOBILE APP: Authentication, Profile, Notifications, Subscriptions
- ADMIN PANEL: User Management, Admin Notifications
- SHARED: File Uploads, System Health

--- HOW TO USE ---
1. Run '1.1 Request OTP' -> OTP auto-saved
2. Run '1.3 Verify OTP' -> authToken + refreshToken auto-saved
3. All other requests pick up tokens automatically

--- BASE URL ---
Change the 'baseUrl' collection variable to point to your server.

variable.description: API base URL. Change for staging/production.
Paste a user _id here for admin user requests
Auto-saved by Get Plans request or pasted manually
Subscription document _id for manual admin override actions

MongoDB ObjectId of a Genre category

item.name: MOBILE APP
item.description: All APIs consumed by the E² Stories mobile application. Covers OTP login, profile setup, notifications, content onboarding, and subscriptions with Razorpay.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: OTP-based login. Run in order: 1.1 Request OTP -> 1.3 Verify OTP. Tokens are auto-saved without copy-pasting.

request.description:
Send a 4-digit OTP to the user's mobile number.

In development mode, `devOtp` is returned in the response and auto-saved to the `otp` variable by the test script.

**Response fields:**
- `maskedNumber` — e.g. ****097
- `isExistingUser` — true = returning user
- `resendAfterSeconds` — countdown before resend is allowed
- `devOtp` — only in NODE_ENV=development
Resend a new OTP. Only works after the 60-second cooldown from the previous request has passed. Returns a new `devOtp` in development mode.

Verify the OTP and log in.

**Auto-saves:** `authToken`, `refreshToken`, `userId`

**Response fields:**
- `token` — short-lived access token
- `refreshToken` — long-lived token for silent renewal
- `isNewUser` — true = navigate to profile setup (Screen 3)
- `isProfileCompleted` — false = show onboarding, true = go to home

Exchange a refresh token for a new access token + refresh token pair.

Call this when the app receives a **401 TOKEN_EXPIRED** error. Both new tokens are auto-saved.
Log out the current session. After logout, call **3.10 Unregister Device Token** to stop push notifications on this device.

item.name: 2. Profile & Onboarding
item.description: New user flow (after 1.3 when isNewUser = true): 2.1 → 2.4 → 2.5. Returning users start at 2.2.

**Updatable fields:** firstName, lastName, email, avatarUrl, interests

 Phone number is permanently locked to the OTP account — cannot be changed here.

Screen 4 — Choose Your Interest.

Save the user's selected genre preferences. Accepts genre slugs (e.g. `romance`), genre names, or MongoDB ObjectIDs.

item.name: 4. Subscriptions
item.description: Subscription and Razorpay UPI AutoPay flow. Covers fetching plans, 7-day Rs. 2 trial initiation, payment verification, mid-cycle upgrades (time stacking), and webhook events.

request.description: Public paywall endpoint. Returns all active subscription plans (1M, 6M, 12M) along with 7-day free trial configuration and statutory compliance notice.

Fetch current user subscription status, active plan name, days remaining, expiry date, and whether the user is eligible to claim the 7-day free trial.

Zero Grace Period: If the billing period has expired or payment failed, isVip is immediately returned as false.

Initiates a Razorpay order for the Rs. 2 trial token. Returns orderId and keyId for client SDK checkout.

Anti-Abuse Rule: Will return HTTP 400 if user has already claimed the free trial on this account.
Initiates a Razorpay order for a standard paid plan (e.g. Rs. 99, Rs. 499, or Rs. 899).

Verifies the Razorpay payment signature from client SDK and immediately activates subscription access across the app.

In development mode, mock signatures starting with order_mock_ are permitted.

Upgrades an existing subscription to a higher tier using Time Stacking.

Remaining days from the current active subscription are calculated and stacked on top of the new plan duration (e.g. 20 remaining days + 365 days = 385 total days of subscription access).

Automated webhook listener for Razorpay events:
- subscription.charged: Auto-debit succeeded -> extends subscription period.
- payment.failed: Zero Grace Period -> immediately expires plan and locks paywalled episodes.
- mandate.revoked: User cancelled mandate in Google Pay or PhonePe -> sets autoRenew to false while preserving access until current period end date.

Syncs player timestamp (e.g. 0:45 of 2:15 = 33.3%), updates user WatchHistory for 'Continue Watching', and increments view counts.

item.name: ADMIN PANEL
item.description: All APIs used by the E² Stories Admin Panel. Covers user management (search, subscription, suspend, delete) and sending notifications to users.

item.name: 4. User Management
item.description: View, search, filter, edit, suspend, grant subscription, and delete users.

query.description: Search by name, email, or phone number

request.description:
Fetch all users. Also returns KPI stats:
- `counts.all` — total users
- `counts.vip` — paid subscribers
- `counts.free` — free-tier users
- `counts.suspended` — suspended accounts
- `counts.activeToday` — active in last 24h
- `counts.avgWatchTime` — average watch hours

query.description: Searches firstName, lastName, email, and phoneNumber

request.description: Search users by name, email, or phone number. Results sorted newest first.
List only paid subscribers.

Set the `userId` collection variable, or replace `{{userId}}` with an actual MongoDB `_id`.

Update user fields from the admin panel.

**Editable:** firstName, lastName, email, phone, promoCode, voucherCode, avatarUrl

Send only the fields you want to update — others remain unchanged.

Set user status to ACTIVE (reactivate a suspended account).

You can also omit the body to **toggle** between ACTIVE and SUSPENDED automatically.
Suspend a user account. The user receives a **403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED** error on their next API call.

Grant subscription access.

**Body fields:**
- `isVip: true` — enable subscription
- `days` — subscription duration (default: 30)
- `planName` — label shown on profile (Monthly Pass / Annual Pass)

For Annual use `days: 365`.
Revoke subscription access and revert the user to Free Tier.

Permanently delete a user from the database. This is irreversible.

For a recoverable removal, use user's own **2.6 Delete Account** which soft-deletes the account.

item.name: 6. File Uploads
item.description: Upload images, videos, audio, and documents. Files are auto-categorised by MIME type into separate subfolders.

formdata.description: Required. Any image, video, audio, or document file.
Optional. Custom subfolder (e.g. avatars, posters, banners, thumbnails, episodes).

request.description:
Upload one file. Returns the public URL and file metadata.

**Auto-folder by MIME type:**
- `image/*` → uploads/images
- `video/*` → uploads/videos
- `audio/*` → uploads/audio
- other → uploads/documents

**Response fields:** filename, originalName, mimetype, size, folder, url, path

formdata.description: Required. Select up to 20 files at once.

request.description: Upload up to 20 files in one request. Returns `count` and an array of file objects, each with their public URL.
Confirm the backend server is live. Returns service name, version, and current timestamp.
